verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents two background mechanisms of its own. SQL alert rules evaluate on a set interval and fire to reusable Slack or HTTP webhook destinations without user intervention. Large SQL operations also run as background batches of retryable tasks with pause, retry and cancel controls. Both are narrow: alerting rules and user-launched batch jobs, not general-purpose autonomous automations. Missing for 10: general scheduled or recurring jobs (cron-like SQL or pipeline automation), agent-driven autonomous workflows that trigger actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
